_comment: DRAFT — derived from visualization_studio_v15.html's reqIndex()/submitReq() (request-level fields only: reqBy/due/priority/bdId). Per-variant rollups (variants, sets, stageDone, done) are NOT stored here — they are computed by querying variant_task rows whose imageRequestId matches this record's id, the same way design_request's own cadStats pattern works but across two entities instead of one JSONB blob. The top-level `status` column (In progress / Delivered / Cancelled) is intentionally left unconstrained here, matching design_request's own status column, since it will eventually be kept in sync by service logic reading variant_task state rather than set directly by a client.

baseDesignId.description: Reference to a base_design row in the (read-only) Merchandising/PIM pim_local database — NOT a local foreign key. Wireframe field: bdId.

requestedBy.description: Person who raised the request. Wireframe field: reqBy / by.

neededBy.description: Target delivery date for the request. Wireframe field: due.

status.description: Declared here (unconstrained, like design_request's own entitySchema.json) purely so validateSchema.js — which validates the WHOLE request body against this file, not just the details sub-object — doesn't reject a create/update payload that also carries the top-level `status` column value.

requestedVariants.description: Variants selected against this request's base design, recorded at raise-request time — BEFORE any variant_task exists for them (variant_task is only created once FG CAD upload is confirmed, via a bff-for-app -> Visualization call; see ARCHITECTURE.md/GAPS.md). Whether a given entry here already has a variant_task is deliberately NOT tracked as a status field on the entry itself — it's derived by checking for a variant_task with a matching (imageRequestId, componentSetId), same principle as every other computed rollup in this codebase. Append via POST /api/image_request/v1/:id/variants, NOT the generic update() — update()'s lodash _.merge merges arrays index-by-index, not by appending, and would corrupt this list.
